stem: As part of the Nixon administration's policy of Vietnamization, the U.S. military —

options.label: F
options.text: trained South Vietnamese forces to take over combat responsibilities from U.S. troops

options.label: G
options.text: shared military technology with North Vietnam

options.label: H
options.text: imposed martial law in North Vietnam

options.label: J
options.text: installed a puppet government in South Vietnam
